About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

 About the Role

CertiK’s security consulting team helps blockchain projects and institutions secure their smart contracts, applications, and Web3 infrastructure. We are looking for a Project Manager to manage the delivery of security engagements and keep clients, security engineers, sales and internal teams aligned from kickoff through final report delivery.

In this role, you will oversee timelines, maintain project documentation, and serve as the primary point of contact for clients across multiple engagements. You will track progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and keep stakeholders informed to ensure engagements are delivered on time and to a high standard, while providing a smooth client experience.

You will track progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and keep stakeholders informed to ensure engagements are delivered on time and to a high standard, while providing a smooth client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the full lifecycle of security engagements, including kickoff, timeline planning, milestone tracking, report delivery, and closure.
  • Coordinate with security engineers, sales and other internal teams to confirm project requirements and ensure smooth handoffs at each stage.
  • Identify and escalate project risks such as delays or scope changes, follow through to ensure timely resolution and help refine delivery processes over time.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients, providing status updates, confirming timelines and managing change requests.
  • Lead client meetings such as kickoff calls and report reviews, support security engineers in presenting findings and remediation recommendations, and coordinate follow-up assessments and retests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of project management experience, with at least 1 year in the blockchain industry.
  • Solid understanding of smart contracts, blockchain security, penetration testing and the ability to discuss technical issues with both security engineers and clients.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating work across multiple teams.
  • Experience in client-facing project roles, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a cybersecurity industrials, particularly in security consulting or assessment delivery.
  • Familiarity with the broader Web3 ecosystem, including major blockchains and DeFi protocols.
  • Experience working with institutional clients, including financial institutions and enterprises.
  • Proficiency in additional languages, such as Mandarin, Spanish, or Portuguese.
The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $90,000 to $120,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

descriptions.job-1w52huq:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Associate Lead to take on our more complex casework, own an area of the surveillance programme, and act as a senior point of reference for the analysts around them.

The opportunity

  • Take the more complex investigations end to end, including those that begin as a referral rather than an alert, and present conclusions to senior compliance stakeholders and the business.

  • Act as a senior reviewer for colleagues' work, and a point of escalation for judgement calls on how an alert or a case should be treated.

  • Contribute to threshold and model reviews, recalibrating detection as trading behaviour, products and market structure change.

  • Support surveillance platform and tooling work, including setting out what detection needs to achieve and validating that it does.

  • Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessment work, and help translate the risks identified into surveillance coverage.

 

What you bring

  • At least 4 years investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Solid knowledge of the core market abuse typologies and how they present differently across asset classes.

  • Hands-on experience with a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize, and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool.

  • Exposure to threshold or model calibration, platform integration, or market abuse risk assessment work.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication, and the judgement to know when something needs escalating.

  • Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Canada, with fluency in English.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

  • Experience mentoring or acting as a senior reviewer for less experienced analysts.

  • Experience of a surveillance platform implementation or build-out.

  • Electronic communications surveillance experience.

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

descriptions.job-1cdxa8y:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

About The Role

We're hiring a Fraud Data Scientist to be the analytical brain behind our fraud models. You'll dig into how our models and rules are performing, spot where fraud is shifting, and tell the team exactly which features, signals, and strategy changes will move the numbers.

You'll work on fraud across card, bank, and alternative payment rails, for merchants in gaming, marketplaces, remittance, and ecommerce, where fraud patterns shift weekly. You'll partner closely with the engineers who build and deploy our models, plus risk operations and compliance, turning data into decisions they can act on. You'll be hands-on with AI-native tooling as a force multiplier for analysis, feature exploration, and experimentation.

What You'll Own

Model Performance Analysis: Track how our fraud models and rules perform over time and by merchant segment. Dig into approval rates, fraud loss, false positives, and drift, and explain what changed and why.

Fraud Trend Analysis: Spot emerging patterns early, from fraud rings and account takeover to card testing, friendly fraud, and bonus abuse. Size the impact and get ahead of it before it shows up in chargebacks.

Feature Recommendations: Explore transaction, device, behavioral, identity, and network data to find new signals. Prototype and validate features, then hand engineering a clear, evidence-backed case for what to add to the models.

Label Quality & Feedback Loops: Own the ground truth. Make sense of delayed and noisy labels from chargebacks, disputes, and manual review, and flag where bad labels are misleading the models.

Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and analyze backtests, shadow tests, and champion/challenger experiments. Evaluate third-party fraud vendors against our own models on our data, and give a clear answer on what to trust.

Rules & Strategy: Partner with risk operations to tune thresholds, rules, and step-up authentication. Recommend decision strategies per merchant segment and quantify the tradeoff between loss and approvals.

Reporting & Explainability: Turn analysis into clear reporting for leadership, merchants, banks, and auditors: what drives model decisions, how performance is trending, and what we're doing about it.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years as a data scientist or analyst working on fraud, risk, or abuse, ideally at a payments company, fintech, or marketplace

  • You've used analysis to measurably improve production fraud models or rules: new features, better thresholds, lower loss, higher approvals

  • Strong SQL and Python. Fluent with the stats and ML concepts behind fraud models (gradient-boosted trees, calibration, imbalanced data) even if you're not the one deploying them

  • Solid grasp of the fraud problem space: card-not-present fraud, account takeover, card testing, friendly fraud, chargeback reason codes, and how fraudsters adapt

  • Comfort with messy, imbalanced, delayed-label data and the judgment to evaluate model performance honestly on it

  • Experience designing and analyzing experiments where a false positive and a false negative cost very different amounts

  • A strong feature intuition: you can look at a fraud pattern and propose the signal that would have caught it

  • Ability to explain model behavior and tradeoffs to merchants, risk ops, banks, and auditors in plain language

  • Familiarity with graph or network analysis for detecting linked accounts and fraud rings is a plus

  • Comfort working with AI-native tooling as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start

  • A bias toward action. We'd rather have a clear recommendation this week than a perfect analysis next quarter

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $180,000 USD + equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.
descriptions.job-0a3gy3m:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Deployment Strategist team at TRM Labs makes sure government customers achieve the outcomes they chose TRM to deliver. As the Deployment Strategist for National Security, you will own a portfolio of U.S. defense and intelligence accounts, from onboarding and training through adoption, value realization, and renewal, and you will help analysts and operators adopt TRM’s tools in a segment where missions, security rules, and workflows differ from any other TRM customer. This position requires US citizenship and an active TS/SCI clearance.

The impact you will have:

  • Act as the trusted advisor for your national security accounts: confidently explain complex technical and investigative concepts, and build the success plans, engagement cadence, and value story that carry renewals and expansion.

  • Get users to their first meaningful outcome: build and deliver demonstrations and structured training tailored to analysts, operators, and agency leadership, to ensure that TRM is embedded in daily mission workflows.

  • Protect and grow your book: monitor usage and engagement, spot early signals of churn risk, and partner with Account Directors on expansion opportunities that drive gross and net revenue retention targets.

  • Serve as the Voice of the Customer: translate national security investigative priorities into feedback for Product and Engineering that influences what TRM builds next.

What we’re looking for:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance, US citizenship, and a home base in the DC metro area (DC, MD, or VA).

  • Proven customer success, deployment strategy, or other post-sales experience with US government accounts, including driving adoption, renewal, and expansion, and training both leadership and hands-on users.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you build and use AI workflows beyond basic summarization and know where human judgment stays essential.

  • Nice to have: a hands-on intelligence, blockchain analysis, or investigative background embedded in the US government.

About the Team:

  • The Public Sector Deployment Strategist team is distributed, not distant. We work across time zones but stay in close, constant contact through Slack and shared documentation.

  • You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and TRM Academy, and you’ll be the person national security customers trust to translate their investigative priorities into what TRM builds next.

  • The team is mission-focused and customer-obsessed. We measure ourselves by whether customers renew, expand, and refer us, not by ticket counts.

  • Decisions get made quickly and collaboratively, with day-to-day account calls owned by the Deployment Strategist and larger strategic account decisions escalated to team leadership.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly customer syncs with your assigned accounts, plus bi-weekly health syncs with the DS team and leadership.

  • Regular squad calls with your aligned Sales team to stay coordinated on renewal and expansion motions.

  • Async daily check-ins via Slack, with detailed documentation standing in for meetings whenever possible.

  • Quarterly business reviews and customer webinars, run on a predictable cadence so customers always know what’s next.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: US business hours, with overlap for internal syncs and customer coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: About one weekend on call per month after ramp, checking Slack and Intercom roughly every couple of hours for urgent customer issues. There is no pager rotation.

  • Frequency: Most weekends pass without a page. When something does come up, it’s typically a customer-blocking issue needing a same-day response.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for customer visits, trainings, and conferences.

  • Frequency: A few trips per quarter, typically short (2 to 3 days).

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Not applicable, this role is fully remote.

  • Frequency: Not applicable.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Level required: TS/SCI (active).

  • Sponsorship: TRM does not sponsor clearances. An active clearance is a prerequisite to apply.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Measurable example #1: You meet with an existing national security customer, capture their internal success metrics, and draft a 30/60/90-day success plan to achieve them, all in the same week.

  • Measurable example #2: A customer’s analysts hit a blocking issue. You pull in Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architecture, get an answer or a fix path, and close the loop with the customer, all in the same day.

  • Measurable example #3: You surface an expansion opportunity on a customer call, validate it against CSQL criteria, and log it with the Account Director within the same day.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $118,000 - $170,000 plus variable compensation.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the role:
Help shape the compliance function of our licensed electronic money institution. You will make regulatory requirements work in day-to-day operations and provide independent, practical advice to management and business teams.
What you’ll do
  • Develop the EMI’s compliance framework, including policies, advisory processes, controls, monitoring and reporting.
  • Assess regulatory changes affecting e-money and payment services, and work with the relevant teams to implement them.
  • Set a risk-based compliance monitoring plan, evaluate the effectiveness of controls and track findings through to resolution.
  • Advise Product, Operations and management on new offerings, processes and outsourcing arrangements.
  • Prepare compliance reporting for management and, where the role requires it, support engagement with the regulator. Work closely with Risk, Legal, Information Security and the AML function.
What you’ll bring
  • Several years of compliance experience at an EMI, payment institution, fintech or comparable regulated business.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements and the ability to turn them into workable controls and clear advice.
  • Experience with regulatory examinations, management reporting and cross-functional work.
  • Independent judgement, precise communication and the persistence to see actions through.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-1bpnexu:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Alpaca, you'll help keep our brokerage platform reliable, observable, and operable as we grow - working across our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, observability stack, messaging layer, and data layer. We're especially interested in candidates with strong PostgreSQL fundamentals who'd like to grow into deeper ownership of our database reliability posture: PostgreSQL sits on the trading-critical path, and we want this person to spend a meaningful share of their time leveling it up while still being a well-rounded SRE the rest of the week.

Things You Get To Do

  • Operate production day-to-day - oncall, incident response, postmortems, and the follow-ups that actually close the loop.
  • Own reliability practice - define and refine SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, and help product teams live within them.
  • Strengthen our observability across metrics, logs, traces, and alerting.
  • Ship infrastructure through code in a GitOps workflow - cloud resources and Kubernetes workloads alike.
  • Look after PostgreSQL: performance tuning, schema and migration review, online migrations on large tables, HA/DR, and CDC pipelines.
  • Mentor engineers on reliability and database fundamentals through code review, design review, and pairing.

Who You Are (must-haves)

  • 4+ years in SRE, DevOps, Platform/Infrastructure, or backend engineering with significant production operations ownership.
  • Hands-on experience operating production services on Kubernetes, and shipping infrastructure as code in a GitOps workflow.
  • Solid working knowledge of PostgreSQL in production — query plans, pg_stat_*, indexing and schema trade-offs, and what a safe online migration looks like on a non-trivial table.
  • Cloud networking fundamentals (VPCs, routing, L4/L7 load balancing, DNS, TLS) and comfort debugging cross-service connectivity.
  • Comfortable with a modern observability stack and proficient with Linux at the operator level.
  • Practiced in incident response - calm under pressure, structured debugging, postmortems that drive change.
  • At least working proficiency in Go or Python, plus strong written and verbal communication.
  • Genuine interest in databases and in growing your PostgreSQL/DBA expertise.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience: large clusters at OLTP load, online migrations on big tables, HA/DR ownership, connection pooling at scale, or change-data-capture pipelines.
  • Experience with typed SQL access layers in Go (e.g. pgx, gorm, sqlc).
  • Production experience with messaging systems at scale (e.g. RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redpanda).
  • Security & compliance experience in a regulated environment (SOC 2, secrets management, audit logging).

descriptions.job-1i4nvaa:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going.

People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in.

The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted.

 

The opportunity

You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working.

  • This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed.

  • Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work.

  • Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix.

  • Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person.

  • Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed.

  • Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team.

  • Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes.

 

What you bring

  • Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system

  • Exceptional attention to detail. You notice what others miss and double-check your work.

  • A structured approach to testing. You can create and follow a test plan, and think about what could break.

  • Clear written communication. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow.

  • Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off.

  • Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions.

  • AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong.

  • Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs

  • Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience testing software products or AI and LLM-based tools

  • Familiarity with Jira, Mixpanel, or similar tools

  • Exposure to marketing, CRM, or lifecycle messaging workflows

  • Interest in fintech or crypto

descriptions.job-1pd2xr6:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

 

Augustus Bank is growing a best-in-class global bank and requires a strong risk function to support this endeavor. This role will focus on counterparty risks stemming from BaaS relationships, partnerships and future credit offerings. The role focuses on risk assessments of clients, new products and services, as well as continuing to develop risk monitoring and reporting.

 

You own:

  • Inventory: maintaining the client inventory and running the quarterly reconciliation against payment and contracting data (you do not own payment/contracting controls yourself — you reconcile against them).

  • Onboarding: running new client and partner relationships through intake and onboarding.

  • Initial & Ongoing Due Diligence: executing initial due diligence at onboarding and ongoing due diligence on the recurring schedule for existing client and partner relationships.

  • SME Reviews: collaborating with subject matter experts across Information Technology, Information Security, BSA/AML & OFAC, Compliance (Consumer & Regulatory), Credit, Finance, and Legal.

  • Fourth Party Due Diligence: extending due diligence downstream to critical fourth parties, where required.

  • Client risk management: developing credit, concentration, liquidity and other financial risk metrics and ongoing monitoring and reporting of the same.

 

Your first six months

 

  • Month 1-2: You learn the business and how counterparty and credit risk runs today: what's in (and missing from) the due diligence and risk metrics, how onboarding and due diligence really move through the pipeline, which SME reviews are current versus overdue, what BCDR and exit plan documentation exists for critical clients, and where the issues log breaks down.

  • Month 2-3: You propose enhanced risk metrics and reporting and support in counterparty risk reviews and risk assessments for new products and services.

  • Month 3-6: You take ownership of risk metrics and reporting, counterparty risk reviews and risk assessments for new products and services.

 

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

 

This role is for you if:

  • You are driven by intellectual curiosity in finding new ways to think about risk.

  • You enjoy cross-divisional collaboration to break through silos and achieve more holistic and faster solutions.

  • You are comfortable working in a supportive, but fast-paced environment where excellence is expected and ownership is rewarded.

     

This is not for you if:

  • You want a fully mature program and tooling handed to you with no gaps to close.

  • You need someone else to define your daily priorities for you.

  • You're uncomfortable owning a deadline for something you don't directly control, like a client’s response time.

  • You're looking for a purely strategic role with no operational coordination responsibility.

  • Detail-heavy, document-intensive work across many concurrent relationships drains you rather than satisfies you.

 

Hard Requirements

 

  • 5+ years of experience in counterparty risk management, credit risk, or a related risk function.

  • Experience working in fast paced environments with a high level of agency and ownership, ideally blending Fintech and Bank experience.

  • Comfortable working directly with stakeholders across various functions.

  • Located in New York area or willing to relocate.

 

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise, and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is $150,000-$250,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

zerohash is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to help architect and build the infrastructure that powers digital asset transactions across multiple blockchain networks. We are a high-performing team looking for an equally ambitious and driven teammate.

  • Implement transaction state machines with reliability guarantees including idempotency, distributed locking, and chain reorganization handling

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you're interested in.

Your mandate is to build a robust, efficient compliance program that supports sustainable growth. You'll lead a team of Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, bringing them together as a cohesive, high-performing regional team. Each will keep their local regulatory responsibilities and decision-making authority.
  • Set the strategic direction and lead delivery of the compliance program across all OKX entities in Europe and the UK.
  • Lead, support and develop Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, strengthening consistency across the region while preserving local accountability and decision-making.
  • Maintain the independence of the compliance function, with direct access to local Boards and the authority to challenge the business where needed.
  • Review current workflows and improve them. Put in place scalable frameworks, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve the quality and timeliness of decisions while keeping controls strong.
  • Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for regulators, leading or supporting examinations, inquiries and supervisory engagement.
  • Partner with Business, Product and Legal on licensing scope assessments and compliance input for new products and market entries.
  • Build strong partnerships with business leaders and stakeholders across Product, Legal, Operations and Risk, giving clear, practical guidance on the compliance implications of commercial decisions.
  • Produce data-driven compliance reports for management and local Boards, using metrics, SLAs and KPIs that show the effectiveness of the compliance program.
  • Take part in Board and committee meetings, as a member or as needed.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex compliance issues, making sure they're resolved promptly and in line with the compliance program.
  • Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
  • Audit current workflows and remove unncessary friction. Implement scalable frameworks that reduce manual effort, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to speed up decision-making without compromising control integrity.
  • Liaise with first, second, and third-line teams to build a control environment that exceeds regulatory standards while maintaining commercial agility.
  • Oversee compliance reviews and investigations.
  • Act as a senior point of contact with country regulators, including leading or supporting regulatory examinations, inquiries, and supervisory engagement.
 
What We Look For in You:
  • 10–12+ years of compliance experience in financial services, fintech or crypto, with a track record of building and running effective compliance programs.
  • A proven ability to solve problems, meet tight deadlines and deliver in a high-pressure environment.
  • Experience working closely with Operations teams, balancing regulatory requirements with operational efficiency.
  • Strong knowledge of EU and UK regulation, including MiCA, MiFID II, MAR, the EU AML framework (AMLD5/6, AMLR and AMLA), the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA and GDPR, plus the UK cryptoasset regime.
  • Strong people leadership, including leading teams spread across locations.
  • Proven experience managing and developing senior compliance leaders, such as Heads of Compliance and MLROs, across multiple countries or entities, ideally within a regulated group.
  • Comfort using data to measure performance, spot bottlenecks and justify resourcing.
  • A proven ability to present the compliance program, risk posture and performance to Boards, regulators and senior committees.
  • Clear, high-impact communication. You can explain complex regulatory concepts to product teams and operational challenges to regulators.
Nice to Haves:
  • Experience scaling a crypto or high-growth fintech business in Europe.
  • Prior experience in the crypto industry.
  • Prior experience as a Country Head of Compliance or MLRO, or in another approved role.
  • Experience working with the MFSA, FIAU, FCA or other European regulators.
  • CAMS, an ICA Diploma or an equivalent certification.
 
Perks & Benefits
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and an education subsidy
  • Team-building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare for employees and dependants
  • More we'd love to tell you about during the process!

descriptions.job-101fpcy:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.  

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Senior Talent Acquisition at Ajaib, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality talent across our global organization, with opportunities to hire across Technology, Product, and Non-Technology functions.

You will own the recruitment lifecycle for your assigned roles, partnering closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, identify and engage exceptional candidates, and successfully close hires across different markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment for roles across Tech, Product, and Non-Tech functions.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, seniority, competencies, and hiring priorities.
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies and build strong candidate pipelines across global talent markets.
  • Conduct candidate screening and assessment while ensuring a strong bar for quality.
  • Manage candidate engagement throughout the hiring process and provide a high-quality candidate experience.
  • Coordinate closely with interviewers and hiring managers to ensure an efficient and structured interview process.
  • Drive offer management, negotiation, and closing for successful candidates.
  • Provide hiring managers with relevant talent market insights, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, and market trends.
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates for critical and hard-to-fill roles.
  • Maintain accurate recruitment data and ensure a healthy hiring pipeline.
  • Contribute to improving recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, and candidate experience.
  • Support employer branding and talent attraction initiatives where relevant.
  • Share market insights and best practices with the broader Talent Acquisition team.
  • 4+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
  • Proven experience hiring across Technology, Product, and/or Non-Technology roles.
  • Experience with international or global recruitment is highly preferred.
  • Strong sourcing and candidate engagement skills, including experience engaging passive candidates.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple roles and priorities independently.
  • Strong candidate assessment, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Data-driven and comfortable working with recruitment metrics and hiring pipelines.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to operate effectively across different cultures, time zones, and talent markets.
  • Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
  • Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you 
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
  • Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
  • Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users.
